svg.title: DhanaDhara DD logo exploration board
svg.desc: Twelve original double-D monogram directions, six wordmark and font studies, brand colors, small-size checks, and client selection notes in one self-contained SVG file.

g.text: 12 original marks, 6 typography studies, small-size checks, and review notes — all in one vector file.
Rolls-Royce is used only as a reference for confident double initials. No badge, geometry, font, or trade dress is copied.

svg.text: Premium confidence through structure, open curves, and movement.

g.text: Stable outer D • flowing inner D

svg.text: Serif-led character without copying another luxury badge.
Simple forms designed for apps, dashboards, documents, and signage.

g.text: Strong app icon • distinctive negative space

svg.text: Font names describe the direction; final artwork should be licensed and converted to outlines.

g.text: Prefer marks that remain DD—not B or a single D—at 16–32px.
Choose up to three concept numbers and two type moods. The selected ideas can then be redrawn, simplified, and legally screened.
Working file: scalable SVG • no external images • colors follow the current Dhanadhara system • concepts are exploratory, not trademark-cleared production marks.

svg.text: DhanaDhara logo exploration • one-file comparison board • v1
